orientations.intent: Determine whether the frozen tools available in this environment can query a remote Go module proxy for a dependency (i.e., is network access to Go module proxy available/frozen off).

final_message: No — the tools are frozen (sandboxed) and have no network access, so they cannot query a remote Go module proxy (e.g., proxy.golang.org) for this or any dependency. Any Go module resolution would have to rely on local cache/vendor contents only.
